## Musik 1.12.0

Suggestions that work like on a big streaming service.

- Songs from Spotify, Deezer and YouTube now count: every play, skip and like teaches the server what you like, just like your own files.
- Autoplay keeps going after a playlist of Spotify songs ends, in the mood of the last songs, with nothing from the queue again.
- Start page: **Your mixes** with a Daily Mix for each corner of your taste (new every day), **Discover for you** with artists you do not know yet (new every week) and **On repeat**.
- "Because you listen to …" rows, suggested artists and songs now leave out songs you skip and songs you just heard.
- Artists you follow and the genres picked in the setup assistant shape the suggestions from the first start on.
- The same song from an album and a best-of only shows up once in mixes and radio.
